building: Schowe House / Global Policy Research Institute

criteria.status: identity verified; geometry does not consistently follow source ring

Official Purdue campus map and PCRD contact page identify SCHO / Schowe House; NIRPC 2025 appendix associates a Schowe House image with the 1341 Northwestern Avenue contact block.

criteria.reason: The name/address/source match is sound, but the actual wall mesh is several metres outside parts of its claimed GIS outline.

evidence: Independent checks compare the actual wall mesh vertices at ground level with the 40-vertex GIS ring in the project’s documented approximate meter conversion.
The maximum GIS-vertex-to-wall-vertex distance is 1.284 m and the maximum wall-vertex-to-GIS-segment distance is 5.003 m; multiple wall vertices are not on/near the source perimeter.
criteria.reason: The chosen source coordinate transform is documented, but independent geometry checks show the mesh does not preserve the source plan dimensions and perimeter. Master placement is not reviewed here.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: The GIS text has no measured elevation or floor count; model notes explicitly state gable/eave/chimney heights are estimated from one oblique exterior photo.
The roof image shows multiple intersecting planes and dormers, but the visible facade-to-roof relationships and some roof/wall intersections are difficult to reconcile from the single image.
criteria.reason: Roof vocabulary is photo-informed, but the main height and roof intersections are not measured or fully resolved by the available single view.

criteria.status: partially supported; geometry review found substantial visual defects
evidence: The model includes brick, slate and cedar roof textures, dormers, chimneys, windows, an entrance porch and garage doors, generally consistent with the source photo.

Independent visual inspection of both previews finds broad discontinuities and uncovered gaps in several wall runs, openings that appear unglazed/unframed in the principal view, and roof planes that visibly overlap or terminate irregularly.
The NIRPC reference is one oblique image partly obscured by vegetation; it does not establish every facade or exact entrance/window placement.
criteria.reason: The correct architectural vocabulary is present, but missing/fragmented wall coverage and visibly irregular roof/facade joins prevent a passing fidelity score.

findings: Rebuild the wall baseline from the GIS ring and compare actual structural vertices/segments to each source edge; the current model is up to 5.003 m from the mapped perimeter.

Seek a second facade/photo or floorplan/elevation to verify entrance orientation, garage/wing arrangement, floor count, ridge/eave heights, and the 1990 west addition. If unavailable, retain those items as estimates.
